advisories.symptom_description: Lower leaves turning yellow with dark target spots spreading rapidly
advisories.diagnosis_title: Tomato - Early Blight (Alternaria solani) with Secondary Foliar Necrosis

organic_remedies.applicationMethod: High-pressure canopy spray ensuring undersides of lower foliage are drenched
organic_remedies.dosageOrRate: 2 to 4 quarts per 100 gallons per acre every 7 days

organic_remedies.applicationMethod: Foliar application at canopy level under low UV conditions
organic_remedies.dosageOrRate: 1.5 fl oz per gallon of water

chemical_treatments.safetyPrecautions: 14-day pre-harvest interval; rotate FRAC mode-of-action groups 11 and 3 to hinder resistance
Multi-site contact protectant; apply before spore germination events

preventative_measures: Strip bottom 12-16 inches of lateral leaves to eliminate ground splash
Enforce drip irrigation; eliminate all overhead watering after transplant establishment
Sterilize pruning shears with 10% bleach between field rows

fertilizer_recommendation.primaryNutrientFocus: Potassium foliar boost and bio-silicon to fortify parenchymal cell walls
fertilizer_recommendation.applicationTiming: Weekly fertigation through drip irrigation line

advisories.estimated_yield_impact: Significant: 25-35% harvest loss if defoliation reaches upper flowering cluster.

advisories.symptom_description: Dark concentric target-shaped spots with chlorotic yellow halos on lower older leaves. Marginal foliar necrosis spreading upwards.

organic_remedies.applicationMethod: Foliar spray with thorough coverage on both leaf undersides and canopies
organic_remedies.dosageOrRate: 2 to 4 quarts per 100 gallons water every 7-10 days

organic_remedies.applicationMethod: Foliar application at dawn or late dusk to prevent phytotoxicity
organic_remedies.dosageOrRate: 1.5 to 2.0 fluid ounces per gallon of water

chemicalTreatments.safetyPrecautions: Wear PPE, observe 14-day pre-harvest interval (PHI), avoid aquatic runoff
Contact protectant; 7-day reentry interval in dense foliage

preventativeMeasures: Prune lower 12 inches of infected leaves to enhance ventilation and diminish soil splash-up
Switch strictly to drip irrigation rather than overhead sprinklers to minimize leaf moisture duration
Apply organic straw mulch around plant bases to seal fungal spores in soil
Practice a minimum 3-year crop rotation out of the Solanaceae family

fertilizerRecommendation.primaryNutrientFocus: Potassium and Silica foliar fortification to thicken leaf epidermal cell walls
fertilizerRecommendation.recommendedNPK: NPK 8-16-36 during fruiting; avoid excess quick-release nitrogen

advisories.estimatedYieldImpact: Manageable: 5-10% potential loss if controlled within 7 days; up to 40% if untreated.
